notes.title: Liminality (1.0)
notes.content:
[h1]Liminality Full Release[/h1]

Thank you so much for the immense support during this year of development. Liminality is finally fully released.

Please note: the game might still have a few small issues, we didn't want to extend the deadline by a few days, and these small issues will be fixed within a few days time. If you find any, please report them in the Community Hub, we might not have found them yet!

[list]
[*] Split game files into chunks
[*] Every chapter now has its own menu (in exception of Chapter 6 and Chapter 7)
[*] Fixed camera movement partially
[*] Removed some annoying screenshake
[*] Chapter 1: Added prologue
[*] Added Chapter 4
[*] Added Chapter 5
[*] Added Chapter 6
[*] Added Chapter 7
[*] Fixed some bugs
[*] Overhauled the employee hotel
[*] Added multiple endings
[*] Added main endings 1, 2 & 3
[*] Removed DLC text from the chapter selection menu
[*] Removed unused locked options from the menu
[*] Removed new game text (saving system has been scrapped)
[*] Removed coordinates on FPS counter
[*] Polished current game mechanics
[*] New "original" loading screen
[*] Changed chapter 1 image on chapter selection
[*] Moved difficulty selection to the chapter selection menu (any difficulty other than Liminal is NOT canon)
[*] Added an option to disable texture streaming
[/list]

notes.title: Liminality 1.0 Announcement
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.0 Announcement[/h1]

Liminality 1.0 is finally getting released (been a while). I agree that this game has not been updated as much as The Backrooms Deluxe before being fully released, but 1.0 will add way more content compared to TBDX Early Access -> 1.0.

I apologize for the lack of updates and [i]mediocre[/i] chapters 2 & 3, but I hope this update will make the game more [i]enjoyable[/i] and less [i]mediocre[/i]. There is also a secret in the [spoiler]looped[/spoiler] version of Chapter 2, if you can find it.

Main changes:
[list]
[*] Ending to the liminality lore
[*] Multiple alternative endings
[*] 5+ new chapters
[*] A prologue
[*] The character's backstory
[*] Bug fixes, of course
[*] Many more we do not dare to announce...
[/list]

Liminality is no longer going to update, and will instead stay on 0.13 up to the release of 1.0.
I would like to thank everyone who participated in making this possible personally. This means you, the awesome community, the beta testers, and a special thanks to:
[b]ojpme[/b]
[b]ThisOne[/b]
[b]Not Sure / A JANITOR[/b]
[b]Zanndo[/b]
[b]Nova[/b]
[b]Lele[/b]
[b]DavidJoacaRo[/b]

and of course to all the people who supported me early on.

(please note that the names are in no particular order, please don't get offended because I didn't put your name as the first one in the list)

In case you didn't notice, this isn't really a "relaxing" type of game, nor is it a "horror" type of game, it's kind of both. If you enjoy liminal spaces, there's no way of telling wether you'll like this game or not, you can watch gameplays on youtube, or even refund the game if it's not your type of game.

Update 1.0 is completely free for owners of Early Access, but may or may not increase the price of the game (depending on what I decide is best for the game)

The next announcement will 99% be the 1.0 release announcement.

notes.title: Liminality Is now released in Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959079/69c8b55baa50e06547902cb2b5ab6f4b6373bafb.png[/img]

[h1]Welcome to Liminality![/h1]

You wake up, but something’s wrong. Instead of your room, you’re in a strange, quiet place filled with endless pools and dim hallways. The air smells like chlorine, and the silence is almost too loud. This isn’t just a weird dream—you're inside a simulation.

As you explore, the eerie Poolrooms seem to stretch on forever. Faded tiles, still water, and fluorescent lights create a surreal, almost haunting atmosphere. Strange messages and signs of others who were trapped here hint at a deeper mystery.

Your memories start to blur with the simulation, and you begin to question what's real. Can you find a way out, or will you be lost in this maze forever?

notes.title: The future of Liminality
notes.content:
We have been doing more work than expected, and because of that, there will be no more Playtest updates. Instead, the game will release soon in early access with a free demo.

Playtest has been released to everybody, but no updates will be released for it.

The Early Access will release with Chapters 1 & 2, and there will be more updates coming gradually.
A release date will be revealed in the following weeks.

notes.title: Liminality Playtest has Begun!
notes.content:
[h1]Liminality Playtest[/h1]

Liminality Playtest has begun, and half of the people who have requested access now have Liminality Playtest.

[b]How to request access[/b]
In order to request access, you have to go into the main game's store page, and click on "Request Access" under the Liminality Playtest section. You will then be accepted in 1-2 days.

[b]I have already requested access, what now?[/b]
After requesting access, you must wait up to 24 hours, we are accepting playtesters every day!
